description: x402 endpoint audit — pass ?url=https://your.host and get the full per-route report for one paid endpoint: does every listed URL answer 402, does the payment-required header decode, is the amount positive, is the network CAIP-2, is payTo present, does the 402 body show a price a human can read, is there an MCP surface, and how fast does it answer.
